data.name: Nelson
data.gender_notes: Nelson is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English name 'Niel', which is believed to mean 'champion' or 'son of Nelson'. The name became popular in England during the Middle Ages and was later adopted by the Norse people. In Christian tradition, Nelson is associated with faith, courage, and perseverance. The name Nelson carries the meaning “Son of Nelson” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Nelson usually hope their child will grow to embody son of nelson and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nelson total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: נלסון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: נלסון הוא שם פרטי שמקורו באנגלית, ומשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא שופטי' או 'אל נילסון'. השם נגזר מהשם האנגלית 'Nelson', שיכול להיות קיצור של 'Nelson' שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא נילסון' או 'נילסון אלוהים'. השם נלסון מופיע גם ככינוי לאלוהים בכתבי הקודש העבריים.

in_greek.name: Νέλσον
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι ο κριτής μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Νέλσον προέρχεται από την αγγλική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι ο κριτής μου' ή 'Ο Θεός είναι ο Νέλσον'. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος συνδέεται με το αγγλικό 'Nelson', που πιθανότατα προέρχεται από το 'son of Neil' ή 'Νιλσון', που σημαίνει 'απόγονος του Νιλ'. Στην παράδοση των Χριστιανικών ονομάτων, το Νέλσον συνδέεται με την πίστη και την προστασία του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Nelson
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Nelson origine Anglicum est, et significat 'Deus est iudex meus' vel 'Deus est Nelson'. Etymologia nominis Nelson ad Anglicum 'Nelson' refertur, quod probabiliter a 'Nel' vel 'Niel' derivatur, cuius significatio est 'champion' vel 'fortis'. In traditione Christiana, nomen Nelson fidem et protectionem Dei reflectit.

in_english.name: Nelson
in_english.meaning: God is my judge or champion
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nelson originates from English and means 'God is my judge' or 'champion'. It derives from the English surname 'Nelson', which is a patronymic form of 'Nel' or 'Niel', meaning 'son of Neil'. The name carries a strong spiritual significance in Christian tradition, symbolizing faith and divine protection. Historically, the name Nelson has been associated with strength and leadership, reflecting the biblical values of righteousness and justice.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nelson gained significant popularity in history, most notably through Horatio Nelson, a British naval hero who played a crucial role in the Napoleonic Wars. His battles and victories cemented the name Nelson as one synonymous with valor and military prowess.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Nelson holds deep significance as a symbol of faith and commitment. The root 'Niel', meaning 'champion', represents the strength and courage that believers should embody when standing up for their faith. Additionally, Nelson Mandela, a former South African political leader who spent twenty-seven years in prison fighting for equality, shared this name. His unyielding perseverance and belief in justice inspires believers to live their lives with unwavering faith and dedication.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Nelson: Derived from the Old Norse name "Njal," meaning "champion of the people," or "sagacious advisor." In Christianity, St. Nelson of Cantalice is remembered for his devotion to the poor and the sick.

historical_references.reference: Nelson Mandela (1918-2013) was a South African anti-apartheid revolutionary, politician, and philanthropist who served as President of South Africa from 1994 to 1999.
Historical records show that Nelson de la Rosa (born 1985) is a Puerto Rican professional baseball player. The name Nelson carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
